_why: Final pre-merge tour (2026-09-25): every surface the branch changes, today's app (master) beside the branch, freshly shot. Plans: tour.shots.json / tour-before.shots.json; theme preview sheets copied from runs/pv-*.
title: Minimalist + Appearance panel: everything that changes, before merge

steps.headline: The panel is now called Appearance and opens on a Themes box, with Layout pictures right below it.
steps.changed: Themes sit in a filled box about one and a half cards tall that scrolls, with Browse and Build inside it. Cards show a framed picture, a slim name strip, and a star that is always visible.
steps.notice: You scroll the themes inside the box; the rest of the panel stays put.

steps.headline: New: Layout, message bubbles, roundness and glass — chosen once, applied to every theme.
steps.changed: Every choice starts on Auto, which keeps each theme as its author made it. Picking a layout also brings that layout's matching message box.
steps.notice: Switching themes no longer undoes your layout or bubble choice.

steps.path: Settings → Appearance → Additional Customizations → Fine-tune glass
steps.headline: New: Fine-tune glass sets each blur and see-through level yourself, for every theme.
steps.changed: Clear, Frosted and Solid are one-tap choices; Fine-tune opens sliders. Sliders that cannot apply to the current theme are greyed out with the reason shown.
steps.notice: The old per-theme glass tweaks are gone — anyone who had set them sees the theme's own glass again.

steps.path: Settings → Appearance, scrolled to the bottom
steps.headline: The bottom of the panel: Effects & chat now has its own heading under Layout.
steps.changed: Reduce Visual Effects and Message Timestamps are unchanged, grouped under an Effects & chat heading.
steps.notice: Nothing new to learn here; the switches work as before.

steps.path: Settings → Appearance, and the theme Marketplace
steps.headline: Theme pictures are now real screenshots of the app wearing each theme, not drawn mock-ups.
steps.changed: The 4 built-in and 8 community themes got new pictures taken from the real app (first two rows shown).
steps.notice: What a theme's card shows is what you get when you pick it.
steps.risk: Themes you build yourself still get drawn pictures (filed).

steps.headline: The new Minimalist layout: no solid bars — the message box and status line float over the wallpaper.
steps.changed: Top bar, status bar and message box lose their solid backgrounds; each button gets its own soft glass.
steps.notice: More wallpaper shows. Nothing changes unless you pick Minimalist.
steps.risk: Not yet tested on Windows; checked before 1.3.1.

steps.headline: Session Files in Minimalist: the drawer floats as its own glass pane.
steps.changed: The side drawer matches the floating style instead of a solid strip.
steps.notice: Same drawer, same contents; only its frame changes in Minimalist.

steps.headline: Games in Minimalist: the games drawer floats like the files drawer.
steps.changed: The drawer gets the same floating glass pane.

steps.headline: Projects in Minimalist: the page sits in one rounded glass pane over the wallpaper.
steps.changed: The full-page Projects screen follows the floating style.
steps.notice: Same buttons and lists; only the surroundings change.

steps.headline: Pages in Minimalist: the list and the page area follow the floating style.
steps.changed: The Pages screen gets the same floating treatment as Projects.

steps.path: Minimalist → switch the chat to Terminal view
steps.headline: The terminal view in Minimalist: the floating top bar stays, the terminal fills the pane.
steps.changed: The terminal keeps the floating top bar and status line.
steps.notice: Typing and scrolling in the terminal are unchanged.
